Create a quadratic matching model from interpretable age-gap preferences

Source: R/union_formation.R
create_age_gap_matching_model.Rd

Convert a preferred age gap and a symmetric half-weight distance into a formula and coefficients for create_matching_model(). Age difference is male age minus female age. Candidates at the preferred gap plus or minus half_weight_distance receive half the selection weight of a candidate at the preferred gap. Availability and eligibility also affect realized gaps.

Usage

create_age_gap_matching_model(
  preferred_age_gap,
  half_weight_distance,
  group_exogamy = NULL,
  prevent_exogamy = FALSE,
  delta = NULL
)

Arguments

preferred_age_gap

Finite numeric scalar in years; negative values allowed.

half_weight_distance

Finite positive numeric scalar in years from the preferred gap at which selection weight halves.

group_exogamy

Optional additive group-pair effects passed to create_matching_model().

prevent_exogamy

Optional hard group restrictions passed to create_matching_model(). Defaults to FALSE.

delta

Optional finite numeric vector with unique group names. Multiply mirrored male targets by exp(delta) and normalize. Omitted groups have zero adjustment. Positive values raise the male target relative to baseline and other groups; negative values lower it. Only differences matter. Does not set pair-specific ratios or change female search rates. Names must belong to the population's identity registry (including declared future groups).

Value

A hammel_matching_model with linear and quadratic age-difference terms.

Details

The quadratic coefficient is -log(2) / half_weight_distance^2 and the linear coefficient is -2 * preferred_age_gap * quadratic. This specifies relative selection weights, not a halving of utility or a realized standard deviation.

Examples

# Illustrative preferences, not demographic defaults.
matching <- create_age_gap_matching_model(3, 5)
